experiment: P3o-P complex-coherence sparse-event ordinal MFT-count screen
research_question: On fresh compound I/Q identities, does retaining template-phase coherence at the unchanged sparse inverse-delay events improve MFT target-count ordinal estimation beyond an identical-capacity magnitude-only control?

prior_boundary.physical_basis: The MFT generator sums real-positive-amplitude circular shifts of one complex LFM reference; phase-coherent deconvolved target peaks are observable while P3o-M/N/O used magnitude-derived features only.
prior_boundary.P3oM: strict local magnitude/contrast event selection is frozen and cannot be adjusted.
prior_boundary.P3oN_P3oO: post-hoc geometry rejection and adjacent magnitude geometry failed; neither score nor relation may be reused.
prior_boundary.mechanism_change: C1 adds phase-coherence values at exactly the C0 sparse-event locations during training, with no count, delay, amplitude, regime or power input.

roles.development: all 33 identities per combination; read once after method freeze

front_end.shared_event_locations: P3o-M frozen strict local positive-contrast maxima, 16 tokens, temporal order restored
front_end.C0: four magnitude-derived token channels plus four zero coherence channels
front_end.C1: the same four magnitude-derived channels plus normalized in-phase value, normalized quadrature value, five-sample complex phasor coherence, and five-sample in-phase coherence
front_end.phase_reference: known 10 MHz, 100 us complex LFM used by the inverse filter

models.ordinal_output: seven cumulative logits decoded to count 1 through 8

stop_rule: If any promotion gate fails, stop P3o-P. Do not tune coherence descriptors, peak rule, model width, loss, training schedule or selection on seeds 1800M/1810M. Do not generate confirmation identities or attach an expert.
next_if_pass: Freeze code/checkpoints/normalizers and test two untouched identity confirmations before any predicted-label-gated MFT-only attachment.
